title: Search Geo Locations
raw_parameters: query:supplySource (SearchSupplySourceType; required) — Supply source context for eligibility evaluation. Case-insensitive. Values: `APPSTORE`, `MAPS`. Controls which `entity` types are available. `APPSTORE` excludes the `PostalCode` entity, which is a `MAPS`-level geo. `MAPS` excludes the `Country` entity and restricts results to the US and Canada. Example: `supplySource=APPSTORE`. Omitting it returns a 400 error. | query:query (string; optional; default=*:*) — Search string. Minimum 2 characters. The API rejects shorter values with error code `MIN_QUERY_LENGTH`. Use `\*` to return all matching geos, or omit the parameter for the same result. Example: `query=San Francisco`. | query:entity (GeoEntityType; optional) — Geo entity type to filter results. Values: `Country`, `AdminArea`, `Locality`, `PostalCode`. Example: `entity=Locality`. | query:countrycode (string; optional; default=US) — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to scope results. When `entity` is `AdminArea`, `Locality`, or `PostalCode` and `countrycode` is omitted, defaults to `US`. Example: `countrycode=US`. | query:eligible (boolean; optional; default=false) — Controls soft-block filtering. When `false` (default), the API includes soft-blocked geos (low search volume, sparse coverage) with eligibility data. When `true`, the API excludes them from results entirely. Example: `eligible=true`. | query:offset (int32; optional; default=0) — Zero-based index of the first result to return. Defaults to `0`. Example: `offset=20`. | query:pageSize (int32; optional; default=20) — Maximum number of results per page. Defaults to `20`. Example: `pageSize=50`.

raw_parameters: query:query (string; optional) — Free-text search matched against app name and developer name. Must contain at least one alphanumeric character and a minimum of 3 characters (2 for CJK languages). | query:returnOwnedApps (boolean; optional; default=false) — Flag that returns apps owned by the caller’s organization when set to `true`. Can be combined with `query` and `cpids`, or used on its own. Defaults to `false`. | query:cpids (string; optional) — Comma-separated list of iTunes content provider identifiers. Scopes the search to apps owned by those providers. | query:storeFronts ([string]; optional) — One or more App Store country or region codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Repeat the parameter for multiple values. All values must be enabled App Store countries or regions, or the call returns `INVALID_COUNTRY_CODE`. | query:offset (int32; optional; default=0) — Pagination offset for results. Defaults to `0`. | query:limit (int32; optional; default=20) — Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to `20`, capped at the service-side maximum (`MAXLIMIT`).
